Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You recognize an attacker’s raised arm from a dream and shout a warning before the blow falls.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
An ally within 3 squares before a visible physical attack.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Call the warning you remember. If the ally hears you, it gains 1 Boon to this defense. No reroll after seeing dice.
